title: The Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-12
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 2448 Tagged. Transfer by Andrew F. 05/2011
source: AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300's > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90's. Set up behind the stage, recorded from the rear-facing P.A. system. Taped by Joe Morrone.

ai_review.summary: Sweet FLAC recording captures a soaring Jerry Garcia on Peggy‑O, delivering an uplifting listening experience.
ai_review.review: The two fan reviews praise the recording’s clarity – even if it’s only 16‑bit FLAC – and highlight Jerry’s ethereal guitar work on Peggy‑O as a standout moment. While no details about the overall set are provided, the enthusiasm for that performance suggests a high‑energy show, and the audio quality is described as “sweet” with no major flaws noted.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers are enthusiastic; one lauds the recording’s sound, the other extols a specific performance, leading to a strong combined impression despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: 16‑bit FLAC described as "sweet"; no major issues reported but some desire for a higher‑resolution (24‑bit) source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Insufficient information to assess overall set flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar on Peggy‑O is described as "almost floated away" – a favorite version for the reviewer.
